title: KL hit by flash floods again | The Star
text:
KL hit by flash floods again | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: A heavy downpour left thousands stranded in flash floods around the city yesterday, with many unable to visit Ramadan bazaars for their buka puasa meals.
Traffic at major roads came to a standstill after the downpour that started at around 3pm.
